tutorial.title: Keeper's Handbook
tutorial.page1.title: Controls: Strike and Hold
tutorial.page1.body:
Move with WASD / arrow keys; dash with Space; interact with E; open the codex with C.

The mouse sets your attack direction. Hold-click to attack continuously; a single click performs one tool attack and is briefly buffered until the weapon is ready. Press X to toggle auto attack: auto mode aims at the nearest enemy without requiring a held mouse button. The HUD shows Manual / Auto.

Esc pauses or closes a panel. Upgrade cards stay locked for their first 1 second.
tutorial.page1.note: The short arrow beside your character shows the actual aim direction, not a damage cone. Blades and impact effects show collision feedback.
tutorial.page2.title: Culture: Ningcun to Yongchang
tutorial.page2.body:
In 1386, Tang He oversaw the construction of Ningcun fort. In 1558, Wang De moved to Ningcun to support the defense and died at Jin'ao the next day; the Wang family later built Yongchang Fort.

In 1559, Wang Lu (A-Liu) is a fictional lamp-watch militia, not Tang He. This game turns coastal-defense memory into a night watch.

The codex separates history, institutions, folklore, and dramatization, with sources for each.
tutorial.page2.note: Historical references: records in the Wenzhou Prefecture Gazetteer and Yongchang Fort: Thirteen Jinshi and the Anti-Wokou Chronicle. Wang Lu is a fictional character.
tutorial.page3.title: Systems: Hold Until Dawn
tutorial.page3.body:
In manual mode, hold left-click and each weapon fires when ready. Collect lamp essence to level up and choose one weapon, passive, formation, or skill. Empty oil means darkness: +50% experience, but faster enemies and less visibility—a risk-and-reward choice.

The market opens every 120 seconds for weapons, equipment, and retinue. Five dragon scales trigger a field clear. Survive 16 minutes, defeat the boss, and meet the dawn.
tutorial.page3.note: Upgrade cards stay locked for 1 second. Replay this tutorial any time from pause or the main menu.
